title: Kind of disappointing
text: Waited several weeks for this to arrive since they only deliver after the specific date each month, and what we got was definitely underwhelming. First off, it was delivered in a small bag and was not even a box, which made the whole experience less exciting. What was in the box was hardly related to BJJ, there was a shirt and a page of stickers that were BJJ themed. Then there were some turmeric pills, soap, and a tiny bag of trail mix. The soap smells good, and was a good idea, but overall it doesn't seem to fit the theme or the value we were hoping for so we will be canceling.
label: neutral
